title: Outcome After Coronary Artery Bypass Grafting
brief_summary: The E-CABG registry is a multicenter, European registry collecting data on the preoperative characteristics, treatment strategies and outcome of patients undergoing isolated coronary artery bypass grafting (CABG).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients of aged \> 18 years undergoing isolated CABG for stable coronary artery disease or acute coronary syndrome. Patients undergoing Maze procedure will be included in this registry.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing any other major cardiac surgery procedure will be excluded from this registry.
study_population: The study population includes any patient undergoing isolated coronary artery bypass surgery.
